name: Hurley Balance
description: Carry and control a beanbag or sliotar on the bas of the hurley while stationary or moving.

name: Cone Lift
description: Use the butt of the hurley to lift and carry a cone with control.

name: Ground Strike
description: Strike the sliotar accurately and safely along the ground using balanced body position and controlled follow-through.

name: Dribble
description: Move the sliotar along the ground under control using short touches with the hurley.
